replay_generation_output.brief: A bounded bridge mission that starts from Nirvana's body-and-pressure core, tests source-code and working-band bridges, then probes current rock that still has pulse without sliding into post-grunge slop or fake-hard posture.

completion_criteria.chip_selection_policy: Use chip selections to refine meaning after the primary reaction; chips do not replace primary reactions and should preserve uncertainty.
completion_criteria.completion_logic: Complete after all 7 route items have primary reactions and at least 10 chip selections total, with trap-item chips interpreted using exception/boundary logic rather than broad lane promotion.
completion_criteria.primary_reaction_policy: Collect one primary reaction per route item. Primary reactions are separate from chip selections and must be recorded for every played item.

completion_summary_inputs.prompt: Summarize the primary reactions across the 7-item route, especially the transition from Nirvana to current rock.
Summarize which chip signals repeated, especially body, current pulse, fake-hard, and post-grunge slop boundaries.
Summarize item-by-item route behavior, including the trap boundary check and the current endpoint probe.

replay_generation_output.hypothesis: The user will keep responding to body-first guitar pressure, hooks under pressure, and production that reveals identity; current rock can work if it feels lived-in and not like a genre appliance.

possible_atlas_update_candidates.rationale: Selected anchor item can support a stable Landmark seed only if body-first and pressure-hook signals recur in future reviewed reactions.

trigger_conditions.condition_text: If future reactions to Nirvana items repeatedly show body-force and hooks-under-pressure, keep the anchor as a stable Landmark seed candidate for review.

trigger_conditions.condition_text: If future reactions repeatedly show current-rock pulse and body on this item or close current probes, consider a Frontier candidate for review.

possible_atlas_update_candidates.rationale: This trap item is explicitly a dead-end check; repeated negative boundary reactions can support a Dead End candidate, but only with review.

trigger_conditions.condition_text: If future boundary checks repeatedly hit post-grunge slop and fake-hard on this trap item, keep it as a Dead End candidate under review.

possible_atlas_update_candidates.rationale: This is a current heavy-melodic checkpoint; repeated positive evidence could support Frontier status, but not Landmark promotion.

trigger_conditions.condition_text: If future reactions repeatedly show current pulse plus body on this heavy current item, keep it as a Frontier candidate rather than promoting it to a Landmark.

review_config.frontier_or_trap_review_policy: Review all risky, trap, dead_end_check, and frontier_unknown items before any Atlas promotion. Trap positives must be treated as bounded exceptions or reassess-dead-end signals, not as lane proof.
